description: Historical Traffic API is a dataset listed in Transport for NSW Open Data Hub (opendata.transport.nsw.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Transport Open Data Hub. The historical traffic API provides historical data on NSW incidents for the last three months. Live Traffic NSW allows you to search for a particular date and location. Please note: If you do not receive a response on your first attempt at retrieving data, try again a few minutes later. Coverage: New South Wales. The portal files it under the publisher Transport Open Data Hub. Its tags are HDS, Historical Data Search, data, historical, live. It offers 2 resource(s) in api, pdf. The portal shows 2025-07-04 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tfnsw-open-data-hub.
